title: Original Wyoming campus announcement
facts: 1.8 GW initial campus; potential expansion to 10 GW. Capacity boundaries and funding were not fully specified.

title: Development partner change
facts: Crusoe no longer development partner; utility says project continues. Over $200 million of customer advances had supported equipment procurement.

title: Google acquisition confirmed
facts: Google acquired the site. Crusoe describes its role as pre-development, including siting, approvals and hybrid power planning. No audited project-loss figure is provided.

title: Definitive Google power agreements
facts: Agreements through 2048; about 2.7 GW resources including reserves. 590 MW grid-connected service includes 564 MW new generation and 26 MW market/retail supply; 2.1 GW third-party microgrid resources. Energy service late 2027, peak load 2030. Generation investment $1.8 billion; refundable equipment advances $399 million.

title: 702 MW fuel-cell project for Google
facts: 702 MW Bloom fuel cells; approximately $4 billion investment; 20-year Google PPA. AEP approximately 92%, Basalt funds nearly 8%. Full operations expected by end 2028; CCS planned.

title: Cheyenne Power Hub turbine allocation
facts: First two M501JAC turbines associated with approximately 1150 MW site-ready power. Gas from Rockies Express. Power Hub investment described as exceeding $7 billion; scope is not reconciled to other announced budgets.

title: Wyoming infrastructure investment
facts: $17 billion long-term investment. Partners include Related Digital, Tallgrass, Black Hills and AEP. Air-cooled data center planned; fuel-cell CCS contracted; turbine CCS undergoing FEED. Final IT load, PUE and hardware not disclosed here.

title: Project Jade and power hub site plans
facts: Power site approximately 659 acres, centered at 41.022293,-104.819811. Planned fuel-cell yard, two combined-cycle units and temporary/permanent aeroderivative generation. Historical water plans refer to section 6 wells; not an as-built Google design.

title: Energy Server 6.5 specifications
facts: Reference model: 325 kW net AC; HHV heat rate 5811-7127 Btu/kWh; LHV electrical efficiency 53-65%; direct CO2 308-378 kg/MWh; no water in normal operation. Not proof of the Wyoming model or quantity.

title: M501J/JAC product data
facts: Product-family combined-cycle efficiency above 64% LHV. Catalog figures are not site performance guarantees.

title: Juniper I-1 sequestration MRV review
facts: Juniper plans 1.5 million tonnes CO2 per year for five years, capped at 7 million total. This is one injection project, not the whole regional hub or capacity reserved for Google.

title: CO2 emission coefficients
facts: Natural gas: 52.91 kg CO2/MMBtu, used with HHV heat rates.

title: PUE and efficiency
facts: 2025 fleet average PUE 1.09. The model deliberately does not assign this measured fleet value to the unbuilt Wyoming campus.

title: Carbon capture partnership
facts: Collaboration targets capture of concentrated fuel-cell CO2 exhaust. This does not establish Wyoming equipment selection, net capture performance or commercial readiness.

title: Article supplied by the user
facts: Reports cost and schedule concerns around Crusoe's exit.
